import sys

def main():
    n, m = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    size = 1 << n
    total = size * size
    oo = 1000000000
    curr = [oo] * total
    for i in range(size):
        curr[i] = 0  # curr[0][*] = 0
    for j in range(m):
        next_ = [oo] * total
        limit = 1 if j == m - 1 else size
        for c0 in range(size):
            for c1 in range(size):
                idx = c0 * size + c1
                curVal = curr[idx]
                if curVal != oo:
                    for c2 in range(limit):
                        done = 0
                        for i in range(n):
                            if ((1 << i) & c1) == 0:
                                up = i - 1
                                down = i + 1
                                if up >= 0 and ((1 << up) & c1):
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if down < n and ((1 << down) & c1):
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if (1 << i) & c0:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                                if (1 << i) & c2:
                                    done |= 1 << i
                        newIdx = c1 * size + c2
                        newVal = curVal + n - bin(done).count('1')
                        if newVal < next_[newIdx]:
                            next_[newIdx] = newVal
        curr = next_
    res = min(curr)
    print(n * m - res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
